prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Pasadena, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1123; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, but I can confirm I'm the driver involved in the accident.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened?

A: It was on a multi-lane road in Pasadena, Texas, during the afternoon. I was in the right lane getting ready to move over to the left lane so I could make my exit.

Q: Walk me through what happened when you changed lanes.

A: I checked my mirror and didn't see anything close, so I signaled and started to move over. About halfway into the lane change, I felt a hard bump on the side of my car. Another vehicle had been in my blind spot and sideswiped me.

Q: Did the other driver stop?

A: They slowed down and pulled to the shoulder a little further ahead. We both got out and exchanged information.

Q: How fast were you traveling?

A: I'd guess around the speed limit, maybe a bit slower because traffic was heavy.

Q: Did you go to a doctor or hospital after the accident?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that evening. My right shoulder was really sore and I had trouble lifting my arm. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedic specialist.

Q: Are you still experiencing pain or limited movement?

A: Yes, the shoulder still hurts when I reach overhead, and I've been doing physical therapy twice a week.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add?

A: Only that I was signaling and checking my mirrors before the lane change. I'm hoping this can be resolved quickly.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
